[ASSISTANT_SAID] Decluttering tips include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Start with a purge: Remove anything not needed, used, or loved.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Categorize and group similar items together.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Assign a home for each item.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Use storage containers for infrequently used items.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Keep surfaces clear of clutter.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Decorating tips include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Create a color scheme for cohesion.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Start with a neutral base for walls and furniture.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Add texture and pattern for visual interest.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Use lighting to set the mood.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Make it personal with photos and artwork.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Room-by-room tips provided for living room, kitchen, and bedrooms.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional tips include measuring space, shopping secondhand, and taking time to decorate.
